upcoming.title: Rich Swanger (Roots/Folk/Blues from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
upcoming.body:
Portland, OR indie songwriter, Rich Swanger, is performing an intimate set of Roots/Folk/Blues music at The Lyons Den in Seaside. Raised in the Appalachian hills of Pennsylvania, Rich grew up singing in church choirs and absorbing country classics played by his father which continue to shape his deeply personal songwriting.

A prolific storyteller and seasoned performer, Rich has released four full-length albums, had his music featured on the television series Shameless, and won the Portland Folk Festival songwriting contest for his song “Didn’t Make a Sound”. His songs showcase both guitar virtuosity and a resonant vocal style – exploring themes of nostalgia, fate, faith and the mysteries of everyday life. For fans of Bob Dylan, The Band, Tom Petty and Josh Ritter, Rich delivers thoughtful Americana music with a distinct Oregon sensibility.

upcoming.title: Jennifer Moriarty Ensemble (Jazz & Blues from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
upcoming.body: Join us at The Lyons Den in Seaside for an evening of live jazz and blues music from Portland, OR supergroup, the Jennifer Moriarity Ensemble! Featuring renowned PNW vocalist Jennifer Moriarty, Mike Reynolds on keys, Russ Miller on guitar and Chris Hale on bass – these talented performers offer a fresh take on jazz and blues that blends vintage standards and American classics in an inspiring set marked by creativity, showmanship and improvisation. Backed by a fantastic band of accomplished Northwest musicians, Jennifer’s powerful voice echoes the artistic bravado of Peggy Lee and soulful stylings of Ella Fitzgerald in a sound that is uniquely her own.

past.title: KMUN Fall Pledge Drive feat. RJ Marx Quartet (North Coast Jazz) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
The Lyons Den in Seaside is honored to host a very special fundraising event for KMUN’s Fall Pledge Drive, with live music from North Coast jazz band, RJ Marx Quartet! Featuring RJ Marx (sax), Roxanne Hill (keys), Dusty Hill (drums) and Steve Maliczewski (bass) — this all-star event will give Seaside and nearby residents an opportunity to help support the mission and work of KMUN public radio. 100% of all donations received will benefit this important community organization.

Guests will have a chance to meet on-air DJs and Foundation Board Members while enjoying a tasty beverage, delicious CHARK-uterie and the soulful sounds of RJ Marx Quartet. Hope to see ya there and thanks in advance for supporting public radio on the North Coast!

past.title: Siobhan Kaplan (Comedic Singer-Songwriter from Astoria, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body: North Coast singer-songwriter and ukulele virtuoso, Siobhan Kaplan, will be performing an engaging solo ukulele set full of passion, humor and storytelling at The Lyons Den in Seaside. Siobhan's powerful voice and unique style compliment a vast repertoire of original and familiar music that defies genres and expectations. Her music is captivating, often sung in a number of different languages, with a comedic darkness that’s both unexpected and satisfying. Siobhan is a gifted performer whose dry wit and often hilarious lyrics provide the backdrop for a truly memorable experience.

past.title: Kara Grainger (Blues/Roots/Soul from Nashville, TN) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Australia born singer-songwriter and Nashville recording artist, Kara Grainger, is bringing her infectious, distinctly modern take on Blues, Roots and Soul music to The Lyons Den in Seaside. Featuring delicately crafted originals and impressive slide guitar work, Kara exudes the raw soul and musicianship of pioneers like Bonnie Raitt and Susan Tedeschi, but in a style all her own.

She has released a string of acclaimed albums, including Shiver & Sigh and Living with Your Ghost which reached No. 3 on the Billboard Blues Album Chart. A seasoned international touring artist, Kara has shared stages with legends including Buddy Guy, Peter Frampton, Taj Mahal and Jonny Lang – building a devoted following across the U.S., Europe, Asia and Australia.

Kara’s latest album, That’s How I Got To Memphis, was recorded at the legendary Royal Studios in Memphis with Grammy-winning producer Lawrence “Boo” Mitchell and members of the iconic Hi Rhythm Section. The record reflects her deep love of Memphis soul, blues and roots music while showcasing the powerful vocals, expressive songwriting and masterful slide guitar that have become her trademarks.

past.title: Mercury Coast (Acoustic Rock/Pop from Tillamook, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Tillamook, OR indie band, Mercury Coast, is returning to The Lyons Den in Seaside with an uplifting set of original acoustic Rock/Pop music. Featuring Eric Sappington (guitar/vocals), Molly Sappington (vocals/percussion), Ebon Bergeron (drums) and Steve Doss (upright bass), this accomplished quartet blends heartfelt storytelling, organic rhythms and roots-inspired rock with a distinctly coastal spirit.

The band’s music carries the warmth and intimacy of folk and singer-songwriter traditions while embracing the energy and texture of rock. Their latest album, Art and Energy, boasts a collection of inspiring and honest tracks including “I Take It All,” “Hallelujah” and “The Loneliness in Your Charm.” With a growing following throughout the Pacific Northwest and countless performances along the Oregon Coast and beyond, Mercury Coast brings a familiar, expressive sound that feels right at home between the forest, the highway and the sea.

past.title: PixieOgre (Psychedelic Dream Pop from Eugene, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Eugene, OR indie trio, PixieOgre, is bringing their “psychedelic dream pop” experience to The Lyons Den in Seaside. Featuring multi-instrumentalists Satya Stewart, Alyssa Baz and Skot Boyes, PixieOgre wanders freely between haunting, slow-burning psychedelia and upbeat, groove-driven rock – blending whimsical melodies, unexpected arrangements and a healthy dose of musical mischief. Imagine a curious collision of Primus and Of Monsters and Men, filtered through a fantastical dreamscape.

PixieOgre isn’t interested in coloring inside the lines. Instead, they focus on creating an epic experience that is playful, mysterious, occasionally dark and always a little unpredictable. Their music draws listeners into a world of sonic textures, psychedelic moods and imaginative storytelling – ranging from tender love songs to murder ballads. Performing throughout the Pacific Northwest, PixieOgre brings a distinctive blend of musicianship, humor and fantasy to the stage that beckons anyone willing to journey a little outside the ordinary.

past.title: Gardentender (Indie Roots/Folk/Americana from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Portland, OR indie band, Gardentender, is bringing their Roots/Folk/Americana sound to The Lyons Den in Seaside. Featuring life partners Kyle J. Glenn and Linoy Yechieli, this songwriting duo explores themes of love, growth, connection and the quiet resilience of being human. They seamlessly blend the warmth of Folk and Americana with the intimate textures of Indie Pop/Rock to create music that feels simultaneously earthy, thoughtful and deeply personal.

Gardentender has quickly become part of Portland’s vibrant music community – appearing at venues and intimate listening spaces throughout the Pacific Northwest. Their song “Happy Song” was recently named a runner-up in the 2026 Portland Folk Fest Song Contest, adding a notable accolade to an already promising musical partnership. Tender without being fragile, melodic without being predictable… Gardentender makes the kind of music you can water your plants to.

past.title: WOLFCHILD (Indie Folk/Rock from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Celebrated Portland indie band, WOLFCHILD, is performing a cinematic set of original Folk/Rock music at The Lyons Den in Seaside. Marked by enchanting vocals, unique guitar work and reverent storytelling, brothers Gabriel Wolfchild and Elion TruthHeart take listeners on a journey through deep emotional landscapes that touch the wild edges of the heart. Their sound is raw, poetic and vulnerable – featuring vivid tales of inner transformation and the aching beauty of Mother Earth.

WOLFCHILD has performed on stages across the world including The Troubadour, Mississippi Studios, Folklore (UK), Java (Paris), Cascade Equinox, Oregon Country Faire, SXSW, Burning Man, Summer Meltdown, Northwest Folklife and more. Their latest album, The Years, is a heartfelt and deeply human meditation on love, loss, mortality and the passage of time.

past.title: Jojo Gold (Indie Roots/Folk/Rock from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Portland, OR songstress Jojo Gold is bringing her vibrant indie Roots/Folk/Rock sound to The Lyons Den in Seaside. Born and raised in Wisconsin, Jojo delivers hauntingly emotional songs that explore the quest for love and meaning in a world that feels both vast and intimate. Anchored by powerful vocals and skillful guitar work, her music builds from quiet vulnerability into expansive, soul-stirring epics. Jojo incorporates atmospheric textures that capture a longing to be seen, chosen and understood – resonating with audiences drawn to deeply personal storytelling and cinematic soundscapes.

past.title: An Evening with Trill LeBeau (World/Soul/Roots from Ha’iku, Maui) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Ha’iku, Maui songwriter and guitarist, Trill LeBeau, is bringing his energetic, genre-defying World/Soul/Roots sound to The Lyons Den in Seaside. Trill blends acoustic guitar, soulful vocals, rhythmic grooves and improvisational prowess into what he describes simply as “something else”, rather than a conventional genre. A longtime member of musical project Cosmic Serenity, his original songs are transcendental, uplifting and deeply influenced by his New Orleans and Lakota/Seminole heritage. Trill feels a strong connection to his ancestry, spirituality and community – delivering thoughtful stories that resonate on many different levels.

Over the past decade, Trill has toured extensively throughout the U.S., sharing stages with artists including Wookiefoot, Nahko and Medicine for the People, Chris Berry, Tubby Love, Amber Lily and Dustin Thomas. Recently relocating to the Portland area, he continues to create intimate, soulful performances that invite audiences to listen, connect and be part of the experience.

past.title: Kent M. Smith w/Greg Lyons (North Coast Indie Rock/Soul/R&B) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
North Coast songwriter and guitarist, Kent M. Smith, is performing a passionate set of original Indie Rock/Soul/R&B music at The Lyons Den in Seaside. A powerful and introspective storyteller, Kent’s songs move comfortably between nostalgic, catchy and emotionally charged – with a distinctive voice and lyrical style that is wonderfully unique and still somewhat familiar. His latest album, It’s Been Great So Far, was recorded at Blueroom Studios (where artists including M. Ward and Tommy Alexander cut records), and mastered by Grammy-winning engineer John Greenham (Billie Eilish). Kent will be joined by local songwriter and multi-instrumentalist, Greg Lyons, for an unforgettable evening of live music, storytelling and community.

past.title: Songwriters Showcase feat. Adam Faucett & William Blackart (On Tour from Arkansas) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
On tour from Arkansas, illustrious indie songwriters Adam Faucett and William Blackart are bringing their distinct Southern Roots/Rock/Blues music to The Lyons Den in Seaside. Adam Faucett is a poetic storyteller whose bold lyrical style and exceptional guitar work lay the foundation for a unique sound he’s coined “Arkansas gothic.” Known for his intensely expressive live performances, Faucett has toured extensively throughout North America and Europe, sharing stages with the likes of Jason Isbell, Lucero, Damien Jurado and others.

William Blackart brings a darker, stripped-down edge to his music – leaning into lo-fi country, folk and punk influences that compliment his gritty vocal style and emotionally complex songs about love, loss and mortality. Together, Faucett and Blackart offer an evening of powerful, fiercely independent Arkansas music that’s as beautiful, haunting and soulful as the landscapes that shaped it.

NO COVER // ALL AGES

past.title: Kelly’s Lot – Peninsula Blues Fest Pregame (Blues/Roots/Rock from Los Angeles, CA) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Los Angeles, CA quartet, Kelly’s Lot, are bringing their energetic Texas Blues and Southern Roots Rock sound to The Lyons Den in Seaside for our Peninsula Blues Festival pregame show where we’ll be giving away a one-day, all access pass! Featuring Kelly Z (vocals), Perry Robertson (guitar), Matt McFadden (bass) and Mike Sauer (drums), these talented performers are celebrating 30 years of incredible music since first taking the stage at Hollywood’s infamous Roxy theater.

Kelly Z’s sultry voice flows effortlessly from tough to tender, while the band showcases sharp songwriting and musical virtuosity that elevates but never intrudes. Their latest album, Late Bloomer, is a return to their rootsy Blues/Rock spirit with honest instrumentation and lyrics that tell vibrant stories of struggle and hope for a better world. Kelly’s Lot have released 18 albums and toured internationally including stops at Waterfront Blues Festival, Riverfront Blues Festival, Nuits de Sologne (France), Caslano Blues Festival (Switzerland) and more.

$10 COVER (INCL. CHARK-UTERIE & GIVEAWAY ENTRY) // 21+

past.title: Charlene & Her Champagne Bruts (Vocal Jazz/Swing from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Join us at The Lyons Den in Seaside this Saturday for an evening of live jazz and swing music from Portland, OR duo, Charlene & Her Champagne Bruts! Featuring the sultry vocals of Charlene Hansen and low-end stylings of upright bassist Marty Main, this talented duo offers a fresh take on jazz - blending vintage jazz, swing and blues classics in an inspiring set marked by showmanship and improvisation. Charlene's powerful voice echos the artistic bravado of Peggy Lee and soulfulness of Billie Holiday in a sound that is uniquely her own. Marty has played on eleven albums of various genres of music, including one with jazz legend Wally Rose. He has played at the Montreux Jazz Festival, North Sea Jazz Festival and the Sacramento Jazz Jubilee, as well as numerous clubs and festivals up and down the West Coast.

past.title: Chris Baron & Two Secrets Feat. Eric Schaffer (Indie Roots/Folk/Fusion from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Award winning singer-songwriter, Chris Baron & Two Secrets, will be showcasing his storytelling prowess and folk/fusion sound at The Lyons Den in Seaside featuring special guest, Eric Schaffer, from Tucson, AZ. Accompanied by cellist, Starchild, Chris’ live shows are passionate, inventive and often whimsical – taking listeners on a heartfelt journey complimented by dynamic musicianship and a bold vocal presence. Currently residing in Portland, Chris has toured extensively across the West and he’s recorded several albums. Eric Schaffer has been recognized as one of Southern Arizona's best songwriters and his vocals have been compared to Steve Earle and Kris Kristofferson.

past.title: An Evening with Mark Paul (Fusion/Blues/Prog Rock from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body: Portland, OR guitarist and songwriter, Mark Paul, is performing a captivating set of Fusion/Blues/Prog Rock music at The Lyons Den in Seaside. Mark brings a wealth of talent and experience to his music, carving out gorgeous soundscapes and lush melodies with his creative use of pedals and loops. His avant-garde approach to the guitar is thematic and complex – challenging audiences to think outside the box while exploring the relationships between music, art and the human experience. Mark performed in Las Vegas, England and Southern CA in the 70s and 80s before embarking on a successful entrepreneurial career, while continuing to perform with and manage Portland bands during the 90s.

past.title: Jerry Garcia Birthday Jam (Grateful Dead Classics feat. Yojo Soul & Special Guests) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body: Join us at The Lyons Den this Saturday for an incredible jam session celebrating the music and legacy of the Grateful Dead’s Jerry Garcia who would’ve been 84 years old on August 1st. Featuring members of Yojo Soul, Red String Theory and other special guests, this all-star lineup will be playing 3 hours of Dead and Garcia tunes. Charki is serving up several Dead-inspired drinks and we’re raffling off a full-day pass to this year’s Peninsula Blues Festival on Saturday, August 15th. So, bust out your favorite tie-dye and take a long strange trip with us as we pay homage to this legend and American treasure!

past.title: The Cider Janes (Indie Roots/Folk/Americana from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body: Portland, OR trio, The Cider Janes, are bringing their Roots/Folk/Americana sound to The Lyons Den in Seaside. Born from a longing for human connection and making music during the pandemic, these three friends turned cider drinking pajama parties into soul nourishing, harmony filled jam sessions. Years later, Naomi LaViolette, Aliyih Bristol and Heather Schrock, have fine-tuned their sound – delivering gorgeous vocal harmonies, masterful guitar playing and joyful melodies that breathe life into unforgettable, toe-tapping originals and familiar favorites that are sure to put a smile on your face.

past.body: Tacoma, WA songwriter, Evangeline Rae, is performing a full-band set of Indie Pop/Rock at The Lyons Den in Seaside outside on our riverfront patio (weather permitting). Marked by enchanting vocals, melodic guitar work and reverent storytelling, Evangeline takes listeners on a journey through deep emotional landscapes that touch the wild edges of the heart. Touring her latest album, “To a Fault”, Evangeline’s sound is raw, poetic and vulnerable – featuring vivid tales of inner transformation and the aching beauty of life’s wild journey. She will be performing with her band, The Drivers, comprised of Kenneth Linskog (guitar), Orien Taute (bass) and Oen Nesby (drums).

Featuring live jazz music from local groups Beacon Street Titans and The Sea Cats, this community event will showcase 6 local nonprofits – Restoration House, Supper Sunday, St. Vincent de Paul Food Bank, North Coast Productions, Elevate Unity and the Sunday @ 3 Series. Come show your support at this free, all ages event that includes food, drinks and some amazing jazz music right on the Necanicum River in downtown Seaside!

past.title: Johnny Franco & His Real Brother Dom (Jazz/Pop/Cabaret from São Paulo, Brazil) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Brazil natives, Johnny Franco and his Real Brother Dom, are bringing their infectious charm and charisma to The Lyons Den in Seaside with an entertaining performance that is both unique and nostalgic. This timeless duo blend original Jazz/Pop/Cabaret compositions with humor and wit – paying homage to the variety and revival shows of yesteryear. Showcasing a sophisticated lyricism, original vocal stylings and jangly Brazilian beats, Johnny Franco and his Real Brother Dom have been shaking up the Portland music scene with their humorous delivery of original crowd-favorites like “Ones and Pennies”, “Cucumber Vodka” and “Immediate Love”. These talented performers put on a really fun show that is highly interactive and memorable. They were signed by producer Sterling Fox (Lana Del Rey, Elle King) on his label Blanket Fort in 2020 and have been featured on Treefort 2022, Jam in the Van 2022 and Pickathon 2024. You do NOT want to miss this one!!!

past.title: Outdoor Concert feat. Carlos Severe Marcelin (Cinematic Ambient/Post Rock, from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Portland, OR multi-instrumentalist, composer and filmmaker, Carlos Severe Marcelin, is performing an eclectic set of Prog/Ambient/Post Rock music at The Lyons Den in Seaside outside on our riverfront patio (weather permitting). Carlos is an adventurous songwriter who focuses on the wholistic journey of “listening” and “experiencing” music, rather than regurgitating trite structures and popular norms. His experimental approach is thematic and raw – challenging audiences to think outside the box while exploring the microcosms of our vast musical cosmos. From his impressionable Afro-Cuban roots to sprawling rock operas with his band Sally Tomato, Carlos continues to blur the lines between music, art and the human experience.

https://www.csmcreates.com/

past.title: Bikini Drone (Tropical Psychedelic/Rock/Soul from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Portland, OR indie band, Bikini Drone, are bringing their tropical infused Psychedelic/Rock/Soul sound to The Lyons Den in Seaside. Featuring Sloan Martin (vox, guitar, keys), Gabriel Porter (bass), Paul Reisender (drums, vox) and Briggs Yahn (guitar), this dreamy quartet lean on their Italian and Orange County roots to create a unique sound that incorporates lush synths, Euro-disco beats, surf/ska melodies and world spy-pop psychedelia. They possess a deep reverence for both timeless song craft and improvised explorations that pay homage to the likes of David Bowie, Grateful Dead and the jazzy funk/soul of Motown. Bikini Drone put on a hypnotic show that swirls and sways like you just dropped acid on a deserted South Pacific island.

past.body:
West Coast Ska/Reggae legends, Warsaw Poland Bros, will be taking the stage at The Lyons Den in Seaside for an exciting night of two-tone skankin’ and rocksteady beats. Featuring founder Crix Poland (vox, guitar), Kevin Patterson (drums), Brent Simpson (keys), Greg Quinn (bass), Lo Natseway (sax) and Andy Wood (trombone) – these talented rude boys have played over 7,000 shows nationwide and shared stages with artists including No Doubt, The Offspring, The Knack, The Specials, and The Skatalites, Pennywise, Slightly Stoopid, English Beat, and Pepper. Known for their dynamic, dance-fueled performances, Warsaw Poland Bros blend upbeat ska rhythms, reggae grooves, jazz and touches of punk energy that’ll have ya shakin’ that booty all night long!

past.title: Outdoor Concert feat. Maggie Ray (Indie Rock/Pop from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Portland, OR songwriter, Maggie Ray, is performing a set of Indie Rock/Pop at The Lyons Den in Seaside outside on our riverfront patio (weather permitting). Ray is a community-minded dreamer whose shows blend humor, tenderness and a touch of wild queer magic. Their yeehaw-pop storytelling leaves audiences feeling both cathartic and energized – creating spaces where everyone is invited to exhale, laugh and feel held. Inspired by the landscapes and contradictions of the Pacific Northwest, Ray’s songs explore grief, belonging, queerness and community. Their upcoming album, Oregon Country, looks both backward and forward – asking how we got here, and where do we go next.

past.title: Siobhan Kaplan (Comedic Singer-Songwriter from Astoria, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body: North Coast singer-songwriter and ukulele virtuoso, Siobhan Kaplan, will be performing an engaging solo ukulele set full of passion, humor and storytelling at The Lyons Den in Seaside. Siobhan's powerful voice and unique style compliment a vast repertoire of original and familiar music that defies genres and expectations. Her music is captivating, often sung in a number of different languages, with a comedic darkness that’s both unexpected and satisfying. Siobhan is a gifted performer whose dry wit and often hilarious lyrics provide the backdrop for a truly memorable experience.

past.title: Lauren Sheehan (Roots/Folk/Americana from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.body:
Portland Music Award recipient and celebrated PNW songwriter, Lauren Sheehan, is performing a set of authentic Roots/Folk/Blues music at The Lyons Den in Seaside. An accomplished storyteller and multi-instrumentalist, Lauren celebrates America’s musical legacy with a diverse collection of original songs that capture the spirit and tenderness of our past, present and future.

She has released five albums and was recently included on the compilation “Sweet Bitter Blues”, produced by Phil Wiggins and Frank Matheis, which pays homage to living Piedmont Blues musicians. Lauren teaches music at Pacific University and performs regularly at festivals throughout the country. Her unique voice and arrangements perfectly compliment a homegrown sound that is both inspiring and nostalgic.
